about: Holds one tab stop for a set of controls: Tab reaches the set and the arrows move inside it.

orientations.about: Which arrows move the stop: across, down, or either way. Reach a set with Tab and press an arrow.
orientations.title: Orientations

title: Roving focus

wrap.about: An arrow past the last control stops there, or, with `wrap`, comes round to the first.
wrap.title: Wrap
